confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for July 2026 peak season, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are the most reliable; accommodation and drink prices are less certain, and the cocktail and wine anchors are bounded by the local beer relationship. The FX observation comes from search summaries citing the RBA and was not verified directly on the RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced like other mid-sized northern Spanish cities with strong tourism, with restaurant and bar prices set somewhat above the Spanish average, closer to Basque coastal pricing (San Sebastian pintxo culture) but with lower hotel rates than San Sebastian. Accommodation reflects July demand in the central Bilbao and Abandoibarra/Casco Viejo areas.
